caveats: Proof profile: the bindings mirror Eluna's Lua method names and registration order, but no live TrinityCore server was available to verify them.
Eluna's event ids follow its own HookMgr enum; treat any divergence as a catalog bug, not a document bug.

Timers die with the object; global timers must be cancelled explicitly.
